name: Guest account disabled
description: Access control. An account nobody owns cannot be granted or revoked, so this sits with access control as a rule rather than with the technological controls.
query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM file WHERE path IN ('/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist', '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist')) AS file_present, (SELECT count(*) FROM plist WHERE path IN ('/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist', '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist')) AS keys_read, (SELECT count(*) FROM plist WHERE key = 'GuestEnabled' AND value IN ('1', 'true') AND path = COALESCE((SELECT '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist' FROM plist WHERE path = '/Library/Managed Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist' AND key = 'GuestEnabled' LIMIT 1), '/Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow.plist')) AS switched_on;
